items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The Sunset was a club where black people could go even though it was owned Joe Glaser’s mother.

ctx.x: Name some of the kinds of places. You played nightclubs, you hear it in the theaters, where else could you hear it?

Well the breakfast dances, the breakfast dances were a big thing. Saturday night… it went late Saturday night until noon Sunday morning and these were clubs on the south side, black clubs where black people went to. The Sunset was a club where black people could go even though it was owned Joe Glaser‟s mother. But it was a club where…
Now a breakfast dance, they had already played all night.
